claims.evidence: The lens appears to be a 55-135mm zoom lens based on the size and design, not an 85mm prime lens. The seller's claim of 85mm is likely incorrect. The compatibility claim is unverifiable_remote as no proof of fitment is shown.

claims.claim: Compatible with all nikon fullframe camera.
claims.evidence: No proof of compatibility with Nikon full-frame cameras is shown. The lens appears to be a 55-135mm zoom, not an 85mm prime, so compatibility is not guaranteed.

claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.
